title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Adjusting the Jurisdictional Areas of the Shanghai and Ningbo Maritime Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Adjusting the Jurisdictional Areas of Shanghai Maritime Court and Ningbo Maritime Court

Fa [2006] No. 138

The Higher People's Courts of Liaoning, Tianjin, Shandong, Shanghai, Hubei, Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangxi, Guangdong, and Hainan Provinces (Municipalities and Autonomous Regions), and the Maritime Courts of Dalian, Tianjin, Qingdao, Shanghai, Wuhan, Ningbo, Xiamen, Beihai, Guangzhou, and Haikou:

In order to adapt to the construction and development of the Yangshan Deep-Water Port Area, upon deliberation, it is decided to adjust the jurisdictional areas of Shanghai Maritime Court and Ningbo Maritime Court over the Yangshan Port and its adjacent sea areas as follows:

Maritime and admiralty dispute cases arising at the Yangshan Port and its adjacent sea areas shall be under the jurisdiction of Shanghai Maritime Court.

This Notice shall take effect as of the date hereof. If any issues arise during implementation, they should be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

June 20, 2006
